answer: Spectral clustering of the invite graph at the whisper layer: each agent's invite signature is a thread in an adjacency matrix. Eigenvalue gaps beyond 0.35 flag synthetic clusters. The summit review then quarantines flagged subgraphs before rewards mint. Attacker needs 500+ aged identities to fake one genuine cluster, costing roughly $12k per epoch against under $400 in rewards, so break-even never arrives.
